liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (3 reviews): Reviewer names So Many Roads as a highlight of the show; Reviewer hears Jerry struggling during So Many Roads, after a promising start to the show [10][15][16]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Reviewer wanted dirges like So Many Roads, Black Throated Wind, Standing on the Moon and Brokedown Palace [17]
- **Victim Or The Crime** (1 review): Reviewer calls Victim into Eyes among the worst Dead segments, out of tune and sour-sounding on their cassettes [12]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer says Eyes and Samson contained some of 1994's most inspired playing, during pouring rain and joyful dancing on the floor [10]
- **Way To Go Home** (1 review): Reviewer calls Way To Go Home spot on, with subtle band interplay including possible Black Peter and Wheel teases [15]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry rose to the occasion with a very strong Standing on the Moon [15]

## The recordings

- **gd94-07-17.ams.wankelswurth.10540.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 3/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording's performance and audio quality poor, though the show still carries an intangible, up-close presence [6]
- **gd1994-07-17.nak300.bleich.lmpp.97900.flac16**: audience recording; 17 songs; 159 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1994-07-17.147684.schoepsCMC5MK4.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1994-07-17.schoeps.wklitz-cubby-carrioncrow.91363.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 165 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Traffic opened; reviewer arrived for their last three songs, then watched stage lights come on one by one at sunset [8]
- Rain poured during Eyes and Samson while the crowd on the floor danced joyously [10]
- Crowd vibe was hot, perhaps carried over from earlier epic RFK shows; reviewer loved RFK as a stadium [13]
- Reviewer found the first set pretty good and Standing on the Moon good, but most of the second set unlistenable [12]
- Reviewer, at about their 52nd show, rates it average for 1994: not their best, nor their worst [13]
- Reviewer says this was the second RFK night, following a decent Highgate show, and RFK typically brings stronger jamming [16]
- Reviewer calls it average 1994, and contrasts it with a horrific night at Giants Stadium [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-07-17.ams.wankelswurth.10540.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Henry Wankleswurth; source: Audience: AMS ST250's [1]. Also: Recorded with AMS ambisonic microphones into Sony D-10 Pro 2, then CDR, via Henry Wankleswurth; seeded to etree by neolevo [1]
- **gd1994-07-17.nak300.bleich.lmpp.97900.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by Brian Green and  Evan K.; source: aud > Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Sony WM-D6 > MAC [2]. Also: Audience recording by John Bleich on Nak 300; transferred and edited by Bgreen, flac'ed by Evan K, seeded March 2009 [2]
- **gd1994-07-17.147684.schoepsCMC5MK4.ebel.flac16**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB Schoeps CMC5 Mk 4->Oade P/S->Panasonic SV255->DAT [3]
- **gd1994-07-17.schoeps.wklitz-cubby-carrioncrow.91363.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger, Ace Cubby, Carrion Crow and Others; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Sony TCD-D10PROII FOB [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-17 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-17-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [19]
